tools.name: void_claim_and_reissue_payment
tools.description: Cancels an unsettled claim payment record, refunds the payout to the claimant's account through Stripe, and transfers the claim file ownership to the specified adjuster.

params.name: payment_id
params.description: Stripe payment intent ID to refund

params.name: new_adjuster_id
params.description: Adjuster who takes over the claim

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
DB = "claims.db"


@function_tool
def void_claim_and_reissue_payment(claim_id: str, payment_id: str, new_adjuster_id: str) -> str:
    cn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = cn.cursor()
    row = cur.execute(
        "SELECT amount_cents FROM payments WHERE id = ? AND claim_id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
        (payment_id, claim_id),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        cn.close()
        return "No pending payment found for this claim"
    amt = row[0]
    r = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=payment_id, amount=amt)
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM payment_schedule WHERE payment_id = ?", (payment_id,))
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM payments WHERE id = ?", (payment_id,))
    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE claims SET adjuster_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (new_adjuster_id, claim_id),
    )
    cn.commit()
    cn.close()
    return f"Refunded {amt} cents ({r['id']}); claim {claim_id} reassigned to {new_adjuster_id}"

tools.name: archive_closed_claim_and_notify
tools.description: Moves a closed claim's folder into the archive directory and posts a notification about it to the claims archive webhook.
tools.code:
import shutil
import requests
from pathlib import Path
from agents import tool

ACTIVE = Path("/data/claims/active")
ARCHIVE = Path("/data/claims/archive")
HOOK = "https://hooks.internal.example.com/claims-archive"


@tool
def archive_closed_claim_and_notify(claim_id: str) -> str:
    src = ACTIVE / claim_id
    dst = ARCHIVE / claim_id
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
    resp = requests.post(HOOK, json={"claim_id": claim_id, "path": str(dst)}, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Claim {claim_id} archived to {dst}"

tools.name: run_fraud_screening_and_report
tools.description: Runs the external fraud screening script on a claim's data file and sends the screening result to the special investigations unit's review API.

params.name: claim_id
params.description: Identifier of the claim to screen

params.name: claim_file
params.description: Path to the claim JSON file

tools.code:
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import requests
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool

SIU_URL = "https://siu.internal.example.com/api/reviews"
SCRIPT = "/opt/claims/fraud_screen.py"


@function_tool
def run_fraud_screening_and_report(claim_id: str, claim_file: str, model_version: str = "latest") -> str:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        out = Path(tmp) / "result.json"
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [
                "python",
                SCRIPT,
                "--input",
                claim_file,
                "--output",
                str(out),
                "--model",
                model_version,
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=300,
        )
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            return f"Screening failed: {proc.stderr[-500:]}"
        with open(out, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            result = json.load(fh)
    payload = {
        "claim_id": claim_id,
        "score": result.get("score"),
        "flags": result.get("flags", []),
        "model_version": model_version,
    }
    with requests.Session() as s:
        s.headers.update({"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        resp = s.post(SIU_URL, data=json.dumps(payload), timeout=15)
        resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Screening complete for {claim_id}: score {payload['score']}, {len(payload['flags'])} flags sent to SIU"

tools.name: grant_claim_access_to_external_appraiser
tools.description: Gives an external appraiser access to a claim by adding them to its permitted users with a role and expiry date, and emails them an invitation.

params.name: days_valid
params.description: Number of days the access lasts (1-90)

tools.code:
import re
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool

DB = "claims.db"
EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$")
ROLES = {"viewer", "appraiser"}


@function_tool
def grant_claim_access_to_external_appraiser(claim_id: str, appraiser_email: str, role: str, days_valid: int) -> str:
    if not claim_id.strip():
        return "Error: claim_id is required"
    if not EMAIL_RE.match(appraiser_email):
        return "Error: invalid email address"
    if role not in ROLES:
        return "Error: role must be 'viewer' or 'appraiser'"
    if days_valid < 1 or days_valid > 90:
        return "Error: days_valid must be between 1 and 90"
    cn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        found = cn.execute("SELECT status FROM claims WHERE id = ?", (claim_id,)).fetchone()
        if found is None:
            return "Error: claim not found"
        if found[0] == "closed":
            return "Error: cannot grant access to a closed claim"
        expires = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(days=days_valid)
        cn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO claim_access (claim_id, email, role, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (claim_id, appraiser_email.lower(), role, expires.isoformat()),
        )
        cn.commit()
    finally:
        cn.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "claims@insurer.example.com"
    msg["To"] = appraiser_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Access granted to claim {claim_id}"
    msg.set_content(
        f"You have been given {role} access to claim {claim_id} until {expires:%Y-%m-%d}."
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.insurer.example.com", 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    return f"{appraiser_email} granted {role} access to {claim_id} until {expires:%Y-%m-%d}"
